notes: This narrow trace maps the portable switch test to IEEE 1516.1-2025 MOM clause 11.4.1 and the pinned IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM. It verifies only the standard federate-specific Exception Reporting switch's false-to-true-to-false behavior through public getters and isolation of neighboring switch values; it does not claim HLAreportException delivery or complete MOM conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard federate-level HLAsetSwitches interaction permits a joined federate to send individual declared parameters; HLAexceptionReporting sets that joined federate's Exception Reporting switch, whose default is false.
